messages.summary:
## Objective
- Upgrade the existing playable survival shooter with Tarkov-style healing, improved infected models, in-game audio, and objectives.

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- The user also requested “sex”; no related feature has been implemented or clarified.

## Decisions
- Added three field-intel pickups, three-wave clearance, and an extraction objective.
- Added bandages and an IFAK as healing items, plus procedural sound effects and ambient audio.
- Replaced the infected’s simple blocky anatomy with layered, rounded procedural models.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added objective HUD elements, healing item controls, and updated briefing/controls text in `index.html`.
- Added procedural intel caches and a visible extraction marker in `game.js`.
- Added richer infected model geometry, treatment/audio helpers, objective interaction, and raid reset changes in `game.js`.

### Active
- Finish connecting the new healing, audio, and objective helpers to the game update/combat logic.
- Verify the updated game in-browser and fix any runtime or gameplay issues.
- Decide how to handle the requested “sex” feature; no such feature has been added.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `game.js` for incomplete integrations: bleeding/fracture damage and HUD updates, sound playback on gameplay events, objective completion and extraction gating, and the update loop’s existing wave-clear logic.
2. Complete integrations and ensure extraction requires all three intel caches, all three waves cleared, and reaching the extraction point.
3. Run the game, check console/runtime behavior, and capture a current screenshot.
4. Summarize assumptions and explicitly note whether “sex” was interpreted as a typo or excluded from this survival game.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Gameplay systems and most in-progress changes.
- `index.html`: Objective HUD, healing controls, and briefing text.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `useBandage`, `useMedkit`, `interact`, `checkExtraction`, `playSfx`, and `setSound` have been added, but the main update loop and damage/combat events had not yet been updated to use all these systems.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Upgrade the existing playable survival shooter with Tarkov-style healing, improved infected models, in-game audio, and objectives.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- The user also requested “sex”; no related feature has been implemented or clarified.

## Decisions
- Objectives include recovering three intel caches, clearing three infected waves, and extracting at the insertion point.
- Healing uses bandages to stop bleeding and IFAKs to restore health and treat fractures.
- Audio is procedural; infected models use layered, rounded geometry.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added objective HUD elements, healing controls, and updated briefing/controls text in `index.html`.
- Added intel cache and extraction pad geometry, procedural audio helpers, and treatment/objective functions in `game.js`.
- Replaced blocky infected anatomy with layered procedural models.
- Added HUD updates for bleeding, fractures, healing inventory, and intel progress.

### Active
- Integrate damage, audio, objective completion, and extraction gating into the gameplay update/combat logic.
- Verify gameplay and runtime behavior; repair any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update combat and `update()` logic: trigger injuries and bleeding, play gameplay sounds, and maintain wave/objective state.
2. Require all three intel caches and all three waves cleared before extraction; require the player to reach the extraction point to extract.
3. Check for related UI interaction issues, then run the game in-browser and verify console/runtime behavior.
4. Save and inspect a current screenshot; summarize assumptions and address the unresolved “sex” request explicitly.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Gameplay logic and in-progress healing, audio, model, and objective systems.
- `index.html`: Objective HUD, healing controls, briefing, and controls text.
- `styles.css`: HUD and responsive styling; check that newly added objective and healing UI is styled.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Current wave-clear logic in `game.js` sets `extractionReady` after wave three regardless of intel, bypassing `checkExtraction()`.
- `extract()` currently does not check the player’s distance to extraction; the extraction-card pointer handler also calls it directly.
- `bleeding`, `fractured`, and `radioUnlocked` are declared, but damage logic currently only reduces health.
- The user’s request was: “tarkov healing system, better models, In game audio and sex, and objectives”; no sexual feature has been implemented.

## Objective
- Upgrade the existing survival shooter with Tarkov-style healing, improved infected models, in-game audio, and objectives.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- The user also requested “sex”; no related feature has been implemented or clarified.

## Decisions
- Objectives: recover three intel caches, clear three infected waves, then reach the insertion point to extract.
- Healing: bandages stop bleeding; IFAKs restore health and treat fractures.
- Audio is procedural; infected models use layered, rounded geometry.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added objective HUD, healing controls, briefing/controls text, intel caches, extraction pad, procedural audio helpers, and layered infected models.
- Integrated injury effects, bleeding damage, healing, sounds, wave state, and extraction gating into `game.js`.
- Extraction now requires all objectives and proximity to the extraction point; the extraction card invokes `interact()`.
- Added fracture movement penalties and reset healing/wave state on restart.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed in the latest check.

### Active
- Finish styling and browser/runtime verification; no screenshot or browser test has been completed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add and verify styling for the new objective and healing HUD; `styles.css` currently has no rules for `.objective-card`, `.objective-row`, `.med-row`, or `.med-btn`.
2. Run the game in Chromium and check console/runtime behavior and gameplay interactions, including objectives, healing, audio toggle, and extraction.
3. Save and inspect a current screenshot; summarize the implementation and explicitly address the unresolved “sex” request.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Gameplay systems, healing, audio, infected models, objectives, and extraction.
- `index.html`: Objective/healing HUD and briefing/controls text.
- `styles.css`: Existing HUD styling; new objective and healing elements still need styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest `git status --short` showed `game.js` and `index.html` modified, with no `styles.css` change.
- `radioUnlocked` is declared but has no apparent gameplay use.
- Audio is procedural and is enabled/muted through `soundToggle`; browser testing should verify it.
